scope: Host-AI video understanding, context and executable scene direction. No model training, benchmark replication or claim of autonomous aesthetic judgment.

sources.title: LAVE: LLM-Powered Agent Assistance and Language Augmentation for Video Editing
sources.finding: Language descriptions of footage form actionable editing context; an agent plans and executes objectives.
sources.implementation: Bind authored narrative, actual source clip IDs, time windows and visual intent; expose them through shared scene/narration tools.
sources.boundary: This implementation does not reproduce LAVE's user study or its automatic captioning pipeline.

sources.title: VideoDirectorGPT: Consistent Multi-scene Video Generation via LLM-Guided Planning
sources.finding: A structured video plan separates scene descriptions, entities, backgrounds and consistency information from execution.
sources.implementation: SceneDecision carries a viewer question, rationale, layout, real material handles and reveal times; compilation produces editable operations with a reproducible plan handle.
sources.boundary: Existing generation adapters remain separate; Layout2Vid is not installed or reproduced.

sources.title: Video-MME
sources.finding: Video understanding spans duration and multiple modalities, including video frames, subtitles and audio.
sources.implementation: Meaning plus sampled visual evidence plus actual audio in one MCP packet, with explicit sampling/timing limits.
sources.boundary: No Video-MME score is claimed, and a contact sheet is not continuous video understanding.

sources.title: Writing effective tools for agents — with agents
sources.finding: Tools should return meaningful context and control response size; tool count alone does not establish agent effectiveness.
sources.implementation: Short plan handles apply stored operations; local meaning is retained while full layer/measurement data stays in files.
sources.boundary: The ergonomic improvements are verified on local tool flows; no Claude model performance benchmark is claimed.

sources.title: Images and vision — official OpenAI documentation
sources.finding: Vision inputs can describe objects/text but have limits including small text, spatial localization and approximate counting; image detail affects processing.
sources.implementation: A bounded overview returns actual image blocks and preserves frame handles for targeted high-resolution crops; no geometry or semantic truth is inferred from thumbnails.
sources.boundary: No model-specific token price or accuracy guarantee is hardcoded, and no OpenAI API call is required.

sources.title: VideoDirectorGPT project page
sources.finding: Planning components and consistency groups make downstream rendering controllable.
sources.implementation: Used as a primary-author explanation of the planning/execution separation; read through Agent Reach's Jina route.
sources.boundary: Conceptual influence; not a claim of implementing the paper's trained generator.

engineering_choices: Event/coverage sampling and file-state caches are local engineering choices, not reproductions of a named sampling algorithm.
Twelve craft patterns are original editorial instructions; three have executable composition compilers. Existing cinematic/effect tools remain available.
Authored scripts are linked to clip boundaries without ASR or synthetic word timestamps.
A small scene trial establishes actual rendering and legibility examples, not the quality of the entire documentary.
